gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-006 concerns a false admissible-region characterization for a Leap–Frog parameter and proposes a phase restriction. It does not diagnose the distinct global-minimizer identifiability failure in I003, namely that the path and finite-index assumptions do not give injectivity or select an inverse branch, as shown by distinct zero-loss minimizers.

ISSUE-008 diagnoses swapped convergence-rate exponents for Adams–Bashforth and Adams–Moulton methods. It does not identify the distinct BDF2 coefficient-table/formula error, the reversed constant and quadratic coefficients, or the resulting repeated-root and real-part values.

ISSUE-006 directly rejects the claimed Leap–Frog region, explains that the root-modulus condition does not impose the asserted constraint, gives a damped-mode counterexample with positive real learned parameter, and supplies the same missing phase restriction as the gold repair.
